description: 01:45 - 02:00: Checked annulus pressure at wellhead 10bar. Started to pressure up tubing w/ cement unit with constant rate. Observed pressure drop after reaching 28 bar indicating that plug opened. Stopped pumping, pressure in tubing stabilized at 13 bar. Annulus pressure at wellhead went up and stabilized to 13 bar.
